name: ai-construction-os
description: AI-powered Architecture, Engineering & Construction Operating System
author: AI COS

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:python"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
